name: code-review-graph
description: Persistent incremental knowledge graph over a repository: Tree-sitter parsing, structural queries (callers, dependents, tests), change detection and impact analysis. Language-agnostic, so it is declared by the common stack rather than any one technology's.

prerequisite.summary: Python 3.10+ virtual environment with code-review-graph installed

local.summary: Local virtual environment (.venv) using uv or python -m venv
local.uv: uv venv .venv && uv pip install code-review-graph

global.summary: Global user-scoped tool install via uv tool install or pipx
